# LicenseDent

> Practice questions, timed mock tests and subject-wise revision for Gulf
> and Ireland dental licensing exams. Every question is written or
> reviewed by a practicing dentist. Covers DHA (Dubai),
> HAAD/DOH (Abu Dhabi), MOH (UAE federal), SHA (Sharjah), SMLE/SDLE (Saudi
> Arabia), OMSB (Oman), QCHP (Qatar), NHRA (Bahrain), KDLE/KMLE (Kuwait),
> and the Irish Dental Council statutory exam (IDC Ireland).

## Exam guides

- [DHA (Dubai)](https://licensedent.com/exams/dha): Exam code GEN5301, DataFlow verification, attempt rules and subject coverage.
- [HAAD / DOH (Abu Dhabi)](https://licensedent.com/exams/haad): PQR, DataFlow, shared-attempt rules with DHA and MOH.
- [MOH (UAE federal)](https://licensedent.com/exams/moh): DataFlow/PQR framework, coverage beyond Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
- [SHA (Sharjah)](https://licensedent.com/exams/sha): Two-stage license, supervised-practice period, DataFlow verification.
- [SMLE / SDLE (Saudi Arabia)](https://licensedent.com/exams/smle): SCFHS-run, scaled scoring, Prometric delivery, early eligibility for final-year students.
- [OMSB (Oman)](https://licensedent.com/exams/omsb): Pearson VUE delivery, Muscat in-person viva.
- [QCHP (Qatar)](https://licensedent.com/exams/qchp): 150 questions, three and a half hours, Prometric delivery, mandatory DataFlow verification.
- [NHRA (Bahrain)](https://licensedent.com/exams/nhra): Mehan portal application, 150-question Prometric exam, instant results, four-attempt rule.
- [KDLE / KMLE (Kuwait)](https://licensedent.com/exams/kmle): Mandatory in-person viva, two-part format, sponsor rules.
- [IDC Ireland](https://licensedent.com/exams/idc-ireland): Dental Council statutory exam for BDS graduates -- Part 1 SAQ + bench, Part 2 OSCE, January lottery.
- [All exams](https://licensedent.com/exams): Compare all 10 exams side by side.

## Product

- [Home](https://licensedent.com/): Overview, live question-bank stats, and exam coverage.
- [Pricing](https://licensedent.com/pricing): Fast Track ($100/1 month), Standard ($200/3 months), Extended ($500/6 months, all Gulf exams) and IDC Pathway ($650/6 months, Ireland only) -- one-time purchases, no auto-renewal.
- [Free demo exam](https://licensedent.com/demo-exam): 20-question, 15-minute DHA-style exam, no login required.
- [Terms, privacy, refunds & disclaimers](https://licensedent.com/legal): Terms of service, privacy policy, 7-day refund policy, regulator-affiliation disclaimer.
- [About](https://licensedent.com/about): Who verifies our content, what we do, and how to get in touch.
- [Contact](https://licensedent.com/contact): Reach the team by email or web form for account, billing, or content-correction questions.
